name: Rating
hint: Hover across the stars, click to rate.
description: Stars that fill to the pointer in half steps; click commits, leaving reverts. A slider for assistive tech, with a hidden input that carries the value in a form. The star under the pointer lifts; committing pops the filled stars in sequence.
usage: Use for reviews and quick feedback. Give it `label` (or `aria-label`), then `value` + `onChange` (controlled) or `defaultValue`; set `name` to submit it in a <form> and `required` to block an empty rating. `clearable` lets people take a rating back to 0. For an average, pass `value` with `readOnly`. Pass `words` (one per whole star, index 0 unused) to show a word under the stars. Pair with a text box when the rating is low; that's when people have something to say.

keyboard.does: Moves to the stars, one stop; read-only and disabled ratings are skipped.
Raises the rating by half a star, or a whole star with allowHalf off.
Lowers the rating by the same step, down to the lowest rating.
Sets the lowest rating (one step, or 0 when clearable) or the highest.

screenReader: A slider named by `label` (or `aria-label`). It says its value as "3.5 out of 5 stars" (`formatValue`), followed by the word from `words` for that star, and says the new value as it changes. Read-only and disabled are announced; with `error` it is marked invalid and the message is read as its description.

dataProps.description: Controlled rating, 0 to max. Pass it with onChange and the stars show exactly this. Leave undefined to let the component keep its own.
Starting rating when uncontrolled; also what a form reset returns to. 0 is no rating.
(value: number) => void, when the committed rating changes (click, tap, keys, clear, form reset).
A word per whole star, e.g. ["", "Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Great", "Excellent"]; shown under the stars and added to the announced value.
(value, max) => string, the announced value. Default: "3.5 out of 5 stars".
Clicking the current value, Backspace, Delete or 0 clears to 0.
Form field name; a hidden input submits the rating (empty when 0).
The form will not submit while the rating is 0 (native validation).
An error you already have, shown under the stars and announced.

Size of one star: sm 20px (a table row or review card), md 30px, lg 40px (the one question on a feedback screen). On a phone smaller stars grow to about 36px so a finger can scrub them. A number sets it in px exactly.
Goes to the slider element (the row of stars), for focus().
Any other attribute (id, aria-*, data-*) goes to the root <div>. className and style are merged with the component's own.

example:
<Rating
  label="How was your order?"
  name="rating"
  required
  clearable
  value={rating}
  onChange={setRating}
  words={["", "Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Great", "Excellent"]}
/>
